unlisted_practices: Locally deployed LLM pipeline for radiology report structuring
Automated QA flagging of Findings-Impression mismatches
Automated detection of gender-anatomy conflicts in reports
Automated detection of undocumented critical finding communication

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and testing a multi-agent LLM pipeline for structuring and quality assurance (QA) on retrospective radiology reports evaluated by radiologists, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
